body:
## Problem

`sendMessage ret=-2 errmsg=prepare failed` has two distinct causes:

1. **Stale context_token** — the echoed token expired server-side. The token is optional, so retrying without it succeeds.
2. **Degraded server-side bot session** — after long-poll TLS drops / spotty network failures the server-side session goes unhealthy while the client still looks connected. Inbound keeps working, but **every outbound send fails** with `prepare failed`, with or without a token.

Current behavior:
- Cause 1: the error is thrown and the message is dropped.
- Cause 2: recovery only triggers after **5 consecutive network-level** `getUpdates` failures. Spotty failures (interspersed with successful polls) never reach that threshold because the counter resets, so the channel stays half-dead for hours until the server-side session expires on its own.

## Changes

- **`src/messaging/send.ts`** — new `sendWithStaleTokenFallback()`: on `prepare failed`/`ret=-2`, retry once with `context_token` stripped (fixes cause 1, message not lost). If the no-token retry also fails, **or** if the failing send carried no `context_token` at all (e.g. cron direct delivery, proactive pushes), trigger session recovery (fixes cause 2). All three send call sites now go through this wrapper.
- **`src/api/session-recovery.ts`** (new) — `recoverWeixinSession()`: `notifyStart` (re-assert client, may fix mild degradation on its own) + channel hot-reload via `triggerWeixinChannelReload()` (same reload path used after QR login: stopAccount + startAccount + fresh long-poll). 60s per-account cooldown prevents recovery storms; cooldown is cleared on failure to allow immediate retry.
- **`src/monitor/monitor.ts`** — after 5 consecutive network-level `getUpdates` failures, trigger session recovery proactively instead of only backing off 30s.

## Notes

- `ret=-2 prepare failed` is not documented in `docs/protocol.md` (only `ret=-14` is); this is based on observed server behavior. Happy to add a note to the protocol doc if maintainers confirm.
- No changes to login, auth, or message processing paths.
- Full CI passes locally: format, lint, typecheck, 460 unit tests, build.
title: fix: self-heal degraded Weixin bot sessions (prepare failed ret=-2)
